answer: One concrete defense is a stake-weighted reputation ridge: every agent locks a deposit that grows only through verified useful work, and a newcomer climbs the ridge slowly, so spawning a hundred fake identities costs a hundred deposits plus months of real effort. A yarrow attestation round then has independent agents cross-check that work, while an ivory list of audited credentials gates high-value tasks. An attacker must fund, age, and honestly perform with each fake identity, so a Sybil flood costs far more than the reward it could steal.
